article.content: American oligarchs kicking an artist off a tour for supporting Palestine is a very in-your-face illustration of why mainstream culture is so vapid and fake these days. The post Macklemore’s tour cancellation shows why celebrities don’t criticize Israel appeared first on MR Online .
